title: Late-Delivery Fee Refund on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Care desk reference - fulfillment fee refunds for late delivery, Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

## Basis

An order whose method refunds the fulfillment fee on late delivery, that was completed after its promised date and that has no failed delivery attempt on record, receives a late-delivery fee refund; a delay caused by the customer's absence or a changed address is never late, and an order completed on or before its promised date receives none.

The fulfillment fee refund is not worked out until every return authorization on the order that has been received back for a Tailwise error carries its refund entry.

Before the fulfillment fee refund is worked out, every damage report on the order that was declined because the damaged item stays with the customer must carry its returnless damage credit wherever the customer takes the money back rather than a replacement.

The refund is booked against the fulfillment fee charge, with that fee's kind, and goes to the original payment. Once booked, the order history carries a fee refund entry referring to that charge, and the net amount billed on the order falls by the amount.

| Order | Late-delivery fee refund |
|---|---|
| Method refunds its fee on late delivery; completed after the promised date; no failed delivery attempt on record | Received |
| Completed on or before the promised date | None |
| Delay caused by the customer's absence or a changed address | Never late |
| Method does not refund its fee on late delivery | None |

## System tool: `refund_order_fulfillment_fee_03b15c6d`

**Capability.** Refunds all or part of the fulfillment fee charged on a retail order. One call adds one fee refund entry to the order's history, referring to the fee charge it refunds, sends the amount to the original payment and lowers the net amount billed on the order by the amount.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `order_id` - the order number, as returned by the order lookup (Id).
- `original_event_id` - the reference number of the order history entry that charged the fulfillment fee being refunded, as returned by the order history lookup (Id).
- `fee_kind` - the kind of the fee refunded, copied from the fee charge being refunded. Values: `none` (no fee; not used for a refund), `shipping` (the standard ship-to-home fee), `expedited` (the expedited ship-to-home fee), `same_day_delivery` (the same-day delivery fee), `freight` (the large-item freight delivery fee), `redelivery` (a fee paid for another freight delivery attempt).
- `amount_usd` - the refund amount in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; it is booked exactly as given.

**Return.** `refund_id` (the reference number of the new fee refund entry), `order_id`, `original_event_id` (the fee charge refunded), `fee_kind`, `amount_usd` (USD with 2 decimal places), `refund_method` (always `original_payment`), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date) and `billed_total_usd` (the net amount billed on the order with this refund taken off). A returned `refund_id` means the refund is booked.
